description_en: Queries a list of quick video production jobs based on conditions such as the job type and state
description_zh: 列出符合条件的一键成片任务，可以根据任务类型、状态等条件查询
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-batch-media-producing-jobs --job-id 0000d80e4e4044975745c14b0000 --job-type Script --status Finished --start-time 2022-02-02T00:00:00Z --end-time 2023-06-05T15:59:59Z --sort-by desc --next-token mRZkKAovub0xWVfH14he4Q== --max-results 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBatchMediaProducingJobs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quick video production job
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The job type.

Valid values:

Script: script-based editing job that mixes media assets.

Smart_Mix: intelligent editing job that mixes media assets
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型：
Script（脚本化素材混剪）
Smart_Mix（智能混编素材混剪）
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The job state.

Valid values:

Finished

Init

Failed

Processing
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态：
Finished（处理完成）
Init（初始化）
Failed（失败）
Processing（处理中）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The sorting parameter. Valid values:

desc (default): sorted by creation time in descending order.

asc: sorted by creation time in ascending order.

<!---->
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results
